Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Luminary Health Q3 onboarding scope & CS ops

Team — quick summary of the Luminary Health closed-won deal and asks for CS assignment. Please treat this as the sales->CS handoff starter. Key points: 
- ACV: $420k (12 mo), start target: 2027-07-01
- Primary use-case: site-wide search/assist for provider/claims documentation (low latency generation + embeddings for rerank)
- Region: US (HIPAA-adjacent, customer has internal privacy controls; they requested SOC2 Type II evidence and audit logs)
- Commitments: 99.5% uptime SLA on dedicated pool, 24/7 on-call for first 30 days of production, weekly sync for first 8 weeks
- Attachments: SOW v1 + kickoff agenda (attached to the client email I sent after this)

Open/known technical constraints: Luminary plans to route PHI-adjacent metadata through Redwood Private (VPC) for initial integration. They want a canary rollout for the search index and will run regression evals on a 50k prompt set we provided. Expect procurement to request additional security artifacts (we've uploaded SOC2 and penetration test summary to the drive link below).

Action items for CS: 
1) Assign primary CS owner and shadow for the first 30 days.
2) Confirm kickoff date with client and own the kickoff agenda.
3) Prepare the integration checklist (VPC peering, KMS config, firewall rules) and schedule a pre-kickoff infra call with Infra Eng if needed.
4) Validate the rollout plan: canary, 2-phase index rollout, metrics to watch (latency P50/P95, token cost, error rates)

My ask: Marissa — can you take primary for this account? Jordan — please be the technical lead for first 8 weeks and work with Naomi to coordinate the onboarding docs. Sean — please add a short runbook for on-call escalation to the shared folder.

Thanks,
Karthik
